ubuntils.notes: This repo's tool, from the venv used for VM testing.

uac.notes: Unix-like Artifacts Collector. Pass --set uac_dir=/path/to/uac (the unpacked release); UAC refuses to start outside that directory, so I2 is N/A. ir_triage is slow: use --timeout 3600.

rkhunter.notes: apt install rkhunter; run `rkhunter --propupd` once beforehand. Exits 1 when it has warnings.

catscale.notes: WithSecure Cat-Scale; writes its archive to the working directory. Pass --set catscale_dir=...
